context: Daichi takes Sho-young out to a sushi shop for the first time.
purpose: Father introducing son to a special food experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、寿司、初めてや!
lines.en: Dad — sushi for the first time!
lines.style: Bright burst of excitement on the opening. Light, eager voice. Quick tempo, each word tumbling into the next. Pure wonder—no performance, just genuine delight that he wants Dad to feel it too.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm, indulgent Kansai drawl. Leans back slightly, genuinely curious what his son will choose. Unhurried pace. The casual confidence of a father who's happy just to be here with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Immediate and sure, no hesitation. Bright voice climbing slightly on the request. Quick decision—he knows what he wants. Eager to move forward, to taste it now.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm, reassuring Kansai lilt. Nods with the words. Slow, comfortable tempo. The casual guarantee of someone who knows this place, who's sharing something good with his son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うわっ、めっちゃ美味しい!
lines.style: Shocked delight on the first word. Genuine taste-surprise cutting through his whole voice. Tempo quickens. Mouth-full happiness, unselfconscious. The kind of honest joy only a child tasting something new can have.
